title: Get started with zupmxode
text: model written rxode2’s syntax read R’s parser, existing rxode2 models run unchanged. compiled native code milliseconds, without compiler.
code: # Open: Q6, should the R functions be pmx_ode_*() rather than zupmxode_*()? m <- zupmxode_model({   ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka); cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl); v <- exp(tv + eta.v)   d/dt(depot)   <- -ka * depot   d/dt(central) <-  ka * depot - cl / v * central   cp <- central / v }) zupmxode_info(m)

title: Get started with zupmxode
text: zupmxode_solve() deterministic core: parameters , predictions , random draws.
code: out <- zupmxode_solve(m, ev, params = c(tka = 0.5, tcl = 1, tv = 3,                                         eta.ka = 0, eta.cl = 0,                                         eta.v = 0))
